title: Status line: show the worktree name when the session is in a git worktree
story: I often have several sessions open and could not tell which ones were working in a worktree. Now the line under the status bar shows the folder and then 'wkt:' with the worktree's name, so I can see it at a glance. In my main checkout the line looks exactly as before.

checks.criterion: When Claude Code sends a worktree name, the second line reads '<cwd>  |  wkt:<name>'.
checks.steps: Install the status line with 'orion init --statusline'. In any repository run 'git worktree add ../demo-wt -b demo-branch'. Open a Claude Code session inside ../demo-wt.
checks.expected: The second line of the status line ends in '  |  wkt:demo-wt'.

checks.criterion: With no worktree field, the second line is the working directory alone, as before.
checks.steps: Open a Claude Code session in the main checkout of any repository.
checks.expected: The second line shows only the folder path, with no 'wkt:'.

checks.criterion: A name containing % or \ prints exactly as written.
The README describes the tag and when it shows.
checks.expected: A Worktree row in the segment table and a paragraph saying the tag shows only when the session itself is in a worktree.
